issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Meridian
products.tagline: Don't let your work go unnoticed. Get promoted!
products.summaryZh: 别让你的工作被忽视。升职吧！
products.descriptionZh: Meridian是一款开源AI工作日志，完全在您的设备上运行。它会随着一天的工作进展，用简洁的英文记录您的工作内容，到一天结束时，您将获得一份涵盖所有工作的总结。Meridian会自动为您的项目管理工具（如Jira）起草更新，待您批准后即可发布。专注于工作，让记录自动完成。无需云端，无需账户。采用MIT许可证，完全免费。
products.description: Meridian is an open-source AI work journal that runs entirely on your device. It writes your work up in plain English as the day goes, so by the end of the day you have a summary of everything you did. Meridian automatically drafts your updates for your project management tools like Jira, ready to post once you approve them. Do the work. Let the remembering take care of itself. No cloud, no account. MIT-licensed, free.

products.name: Omni by xpander
products.tagline: Stop babysitting your AI agents
products.summaryZh: 别再像保姆一样盯着你的AI代理了。
products.descriptionZh: Omni是一款AI工程师，能将你的智能体从笔记本电脑带到云端。如今，你最好的AI工作流仍停留在本机的Claude中——合上盖子就停止，只为你一人运行。描述你的需求，或带上你已构建的内容，Omni会连接工具与技能，在模拟数据上测试，并交付一个运行中的云端智能体：可定时、可长时间运行、可与团队共享。它还能维护智能体的健康——优化系统提示词、比较模型、调试并修复失败的运行。
products.description: Omni is the AI engineer that takes your agents from a laptop to the cloud. Today, your best AI workflows still live in Claude on your machine - stopping when the lid closes, running for no one but you. Describe what you want, or bring what you've built, and Omni wires the tools and skills, tests on mock data, and hands you a running cloud agent: scheduled, long-running, shareable with your team. It keeps agents healthy too - improves system prompts, compares models, debugs and fixes failed runs.

products.name: Clears
products.tagline: Move beyond AI coding to Agentic Software Delivery
products.summaryZh: 超越AI编码，迈向智能体软件交付
products.descriptionZh: Clears是一个面向自主软件交付的智能体执行平台，帮助研发组织超越单一AI工具，实现覆盖整个软件开发生命周期的智能体执行。
products.description: Clears is an agentic execution platform for autonomous software delivery, helping R&D organizations move beyond individual AI tools to agentic execution across the entire SDLC.

products.name: Vendo
products.tagline: Let your users build their own features inside your product
products.summaryZh: 让您的用户在产品内部自行构建功能。
products.descriptionZh: Vendo是一个开源定制层，嵌入你的产品中，让每位客户只需描述需求，就能添加所需的功能和微应用。此前，软件是僵化的，每位客户都不得不去适应它。Vendo使其变得动态，让产品围绕每位客户自我塑造，基于你自己的API构建，并遵循你设定的边界。
products.description: Vendo is an open-source customization layer in your product that lets every customer add the features and micro-apps they need, just by describing what they want. Until now software has been rigid, and every customer had to adapt to it. Vendo makes it dynamic, so your product shapes itself around each customer, built on your own API and inside the guardrails you set.

products.name: Scholé Scenarios
products.tagline: Learn by doing
products.summaryZh: 在实践中学习
products.descriptionZh: 大多数学习只告诉你该知道什么，却不让你练习实际要做的内容。Scholé Scenarios通过将真实世界场景融入自适应学习，改变了这一点。你将在课程中练习真实情境：向队友解释刚学到的内容、挽回销售、与客户进行有见地的讨论。Scholé是一个代理式学习系统，能调整后续学习内容，让你练习关键时刻。
products.description: Most learning tells you what to know, but doesn’t let you practice what you’ll actually do. Scholé Scenarios changes that by bringing real-world scenarios into adaptive learning. You will practice real situations throughout your lessons: explain what you just learned to a teammate, save the sale, discuss knowledgeably with a client. Scholé is an agentic learning system to adapt the learning that comes next, so you can practice the moments that matter.

products.name: OpenTrade
products.tagline: Open-source trading harness for Claude Code / Codex.
products.summaryZh: 开源交易工具，适用于Claude Code / Codex。
products.descriptionZh: OpenTrade是一个开源工具集，为Claude Code / Codex代理提供通过Robinhood官方MCP进行有效交易的工具和护栏。开箱即用，代理可以在你的机器上设置定时任务、自定义脚本以自我通知，以及持久后台会话。
products.description: OpenTrade is an open-source harness for Claude Code / Codex agents that provide the tools and guardrails to trade effectively via Robinhood's official MCP. Out of the box, agents can setup cron schedules, custom scripts to notify themselves, and persistent background sessions – all on your machine.

products.name: Treg
products.tagline: OpenRouter for tools with 2,600 APIs, 0% markup
products.summaryZh: OpenRouter工具平台，提供2,600个API，零加价
products.descriptionZh: 智能体并不关心供应商——它们只想要最适合任务的API。treg为你的智能体提供2600多种工具（SEO、社交、线索、广告、抓取），只需一个URL和一个令牌。按任务搜索，查看价格/请求/响应，按调用付费，零加价。开源。
products.description: Agents don't care about vendors - they want the best API for the task. treg gives your agent 2,600+ tools (SEO, social, leads, ads, scraping) behind one URL and one token. Search by task, see price/request/response, pay per call at 0% markup. Open source.

products.name: Replay QA for Teams
products.tagline: Autonomous QA for teams who ship faster than they can verify
products.summaryZh: 为比验证速度更快的团队提供的自主QA方案
products.descriptionZh: Replay QA像真实用户一样测试你的Web应用，在问题影响客户之前发现故障流程、界面问题和缺陷。它提供每个问题背后的上下文，并给出修复建议。新增功能：通过共享项目、团队成员提及、本地主机测试以及每次拉取请求的QA检查，你的整个团队可以在发布前发现并修复问题。
products.description: Replay QA tests your web app like a real user, uncovering broken flows, UI issues, and bugs before they reach customers. It gives you the context behind each issue, plus suggested fixes. What's new: With shared projects, teammate mentions, localhost testing, and QA checks on every pull request, your whole team can catch and fix problems before shipping.

products.name: Startup Program by Recall.ai
products.tagline: Startup program for meeting recording infrastructure
products.summaryZh: 会议录制基础设施的启动程序
products.descriptionZh: Recall.ai创业计划为早期团队提供可靠的会议录制基础设施，前10,000小时按每小时0.25美元计费，并附带工程师支持、快速机器人加入、所有录制产品、MCP访问及日历集成。
products.description: The Recall.ai Startup Program gives early-stage teams reliable meeting recording infrastructure at $0.25/hour for their first 10,000 hours, plus engineer support, fast bot joins, every recording product, MCP access, and calendar integration.

products.name: Samepage Artifacts
products.tagline: A context-aware, connected writing surface for product teams
products.summaryZh: 面向产品团队的上下文感知型互联写作平台
products.descriptionZh: Samepage的Artifacts是您的互联产品管理写作界面，草稿自动生成并随时待命：产品需求文档、发布说明、功能简报、每周更新等。
products.description: Artifacts by Samepage is your connected product management writing surface, where drafts are automatically generated and waiting for you: PRDs, release notes, feature briefs, weekly updates, and more.

products.name: Bulbthings
products.tagline: The AI platform to track and manage your physical assets
products.summaryZh: 用于追踪和管理实物资产的AI平台
products.descriptionZh: 你的业务依赖很多实物资产：设备、工具、家具、车辆——但大多数团队仍用电子表格和WhatsApp来管理这一切。Bulbthings是一个AI驱动的资产管理平台，将库存、预订、维护和协作整合在一起，在桌面端和移动端都体验出色。无需培训，无需混乱。只需一个真实数据源，管理你企业拥有的每一件实体物品。
products.description: Your business runs on a lot of stuff. Gear, equipment, tools, furniture, vehicles — yet most teams still track it all across spreadsheets and WhatsApp. Bulbthings is the AI-powered asset management platform that brings everything together: inventory, bookings, maintenance, and collaboration — beautifully, on desktop and mobile. No training needed, no chaos. Just one source of truth for every physical thing your business owns.

products.name: Hansel by Seedling
products.tagline: Your email, your server, your keys so you're not locked out
products.summaryZh: 你的邮箱，你的服务器，你的密钥，让你永不失联。
products.descriptionZh: Hansel是面向重视隐私与数据所有权的团队的Gmail/Outlook替代品。您的邮件运行在您自己的服务器上。消息在您的设备上加密。平台无法读取它们。垃圾邮件在架构层面得到解决——没有您的密钥，消息无法送达。包含加密消息、自有域名邮箱、日历、笔记及企业管理员工具。没有任何公司能将您拒之门外。永远。
products.description: Hansel is a gmail/outlook replacement for teams that value privacy and ownership. Your email runs on YOUR server. Messages encrypt on YOUR device. The platform cannot read them. Spam is solved architecturally without your key, messages can't arrive. Includes encrypted messaging, email from your own domain, calendar, notes, and enterprise admin tools. No company can lock you out. Ever.

products.name: TinyFish
products.tagline: The web operating layer for AI agents
products.summaryZh: AI代理的Web操作系统层
products.descriptionZh: TinyFish是一个为AI代理和AI应用打造的统一Web操作平台。它使开发者能够通过单一平台搜索实时网页、提取干净的结构化内容、浏览动态网站，并自动化经过认证的工作流程。通过提供对当前Web数据和Web交互的可靠访问，TinyFish帮助AI系统提供更准确的答案、降低运营复杂性，并扩展生产工作负载。
products.description: TinyFish is a unified web operations platform built for AI agents and AI applications. It enables developers to search the live web, extract clean structured content, browse dynamic websites, and automate authenticated workflows through a single platform. By providing reliable access to current web data and web interactions, TinyFish helps AI systems deliver more accurate answers, reduce operational complexity, and scale production workloads.

products.name: envfix
products.tagline: A tiny .env doctor for Node.js projects
products.summaryZh: 一个用于Node.js项目的小型.env检查工具
products.descriptionZh: envfix 是一个零依赖的命令行工具，用于诊断和修复环境配置问题。它能检测缺失、空值、多余及重复的变量，捕获格式错误的声明，检查 Git 安全性，生成并同步示例环境文件，并支持本地或 CI 环境运行。通过 npx envfix 即可立即使用。
products.description: envfix is a zero-dependency CLI for diagnosing and fixing environment configuration problems. It detects missing, empty, extra, and duplicate variables, catches malformed declarations, checks Git safety, generates and syncs example environment files, and works locally or in CI. Run it instantly with npx envfix.

products.name: Blender Agent Bridge
products.tagline: Open-source MCP bridge for Blender AI workflows
products.summaryZh: Blender AI 工作流的开源 MCP 桥接器
products.descriptionZh: Blender Agent Bridge 是一款免费开源的 Blender 扩展，通过 MCP 将 Blender 与 Codex、Claude 和 Cursor 等 AI 客户端连接起来。它允许代理检查场景、收集视觉证据并协助工作流程，同时将编辑、脚本信任、付费生成和审批控制权保留在艺术家手中。它集成了 Meshy.ai、Tripo3D、Polyhaven 等平台。
products.description: Blender Agent Bridge is a free, open-source Blender extension that connects Blender to AI clients like Codex, Claude, and Cursor through MCP. It lets agents inspect scenes, gather visual evidence, and assist with workflows while keeping edits, script trust, paid generation, and approvals under the artist’s control. It Has integration with Meshy.ai, Tripo3D, Polyhaven and more.

products.name: Talentz
products.tagline: The signal layer for hiring.
products.summaryZh: 招聘的信号层。
products.descriptionZh: Zee是Talentz.ai背后的代理式招聘平台。三个相互连接的代理覆盖了你的完整招聘前流程。Zee Scout通过工作成果寻找候选人，在人才真正活跃的地方进行搜索。Zee Engage在单一线程上跨所有渠道运行双向对话。Zee Lens进行结构化AI视频面试，并提供可直接用于决策的发现。你的招聘经理基于证据而非简历做出决定。
products.description: Zee is the agentic recruiting platform behind Talentz.ai. Three connected agents cover your full pre-hire loop. Zee Scout finds candidates by proof of work, searching where talent actually lives. Zee Engage runs two-way conversations across every channel on one thread. Zee Lens conducts structured AI video interviews and delivers decision-ready findings. Your hiring manager makes the call, backed by evidence instead of a resume.

products.name: Text2Test | 0 → Test Suite in Minutes
products.tagline: Turn plain text into automated tests in minutes.
products.summaryZh: 几分钟内将纯文本转化为自动化测试。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数测试自动化让你像机器一样思考：寻找选择器，编写脆弱的脚本，界面变动时修复它们。Text2Test颠覆了这一点。用纯文本描述测试。我们的模型将其编译为在真实浏览器上运行的确定性测试，并随着应用演进自我修复。无需代码。无需选择器。无需设置。无令牌陷阱。AI测试工具每次运行测试都收费。AI帮你创建测试，而非重复运行。成本随构建内容增长，而非运行频率。
products.description: Most test automation makes you think like a machine: hunt selectors, write brittle scripts, fix them when UI shifts. Text2Test flips that. Describe a test in plain text. Our model compiles it into a deterministic test that runs on real browsers and heals itself as your app evolves. No code. No selectors. No setup. No token trap. AI testing tools charge you every time tests run. AI helps you create tests, not run them on repeat. Costs scale with what you build, not how often it runs.

products.name: HookLens
products.tagline: Real-time webhook triage & AI root-cause analysis
products.summaryZh: 实时Webhook分类与AI根因分析
products.descriptionZh: 使用Gemini AI即时调试、监控并分类失败的Stripe和Shopify Webhooks。将晦涩的JSON数据转化为清晰的根因分析和可直接落地的修复代码。
products.description: Debug, monitor, and triage failed Stripe and Shopify webhooks instantly with Gemini AI. Turn cryptic JSON payloads into clear root causes and code-ready fixes.

products.name: Skriptr
products.tagline: AI workspace for students
products.summaryZh: 面向学生的AI工作空间
products.descriptionZh: Skriptr是面向学生的AI工作空间，助力研究、写作与学习。Skriptr能阅读你的资料，为每个答案展示确切出处页面，并主动提问。它与你协作，而非代劳。思考始终属于你。
products.description: Skriptr is the AI workspace for students, helping with research, writing, and learning. Skriptr reads your sources, shows the exact page behind every answer, and asks questions back. It work with you, not for you. The thinking stays yours.

products.name: Reticket
products.tagline: Ticket resale where fake listings are impossible
products.summaryZh: 杜绝虚假票务信息的二手票转让平台
products.descriptionZh: Reticket是一个以验证为先的票务转售市场。每一条列表都通过零知识证明对卖家的原始预订进行加密验证，价格上限为购买价，经过KYC验证的卖家需锁定不可撤销的保证金，且款项仅在活动结束后释放。
products.description: Reticket is a verification-first ticket resale marketplace. Every listing is cryptographically verified using zero knowledge proof against the seller's original booking, prices are capped at purchase price, KYC-verified sellers lock a non-revocable security deposit, and payouts release only after the event happens.
